game_concept: A action puzzle set in Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing, a sandbar at low tide: the deckhand must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Else Escape: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of sea serpents, dodge the other.
theme: Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing: a sandbar at low tide
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandbar Crossing, repeat each round: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of sea serpents, dodge the other. Each round, a new fishing nets challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the hero_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 320 points of fishing nets by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 320, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Else Escape
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Else Escape' (Week 3 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sandbar Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how hero_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sea serpents in Sandbar Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 320 within 80 seconds.
